posts.name: Power Armor
posts.cooked:
Mickey Rorq Junior:

So thieving is ok, but outing a thief isn’t?

c o n s e q u e n c e s

Yes, consequences. Have you ever thought that this occurs on a daily basis and the forums would explode if everyone posted about who did what?

And secondly, have you ever thought about EVE being a “social” game with human interaction that can trigger such things as falsely accusing someone for just that many reasons or even none at all?

Neither the wrongdoing nor the false accusation is verifiable in any case.

Why would anyone need this information in a forum? Capable corp recruiters would do background checks on the corp history of a character anyway. A short talk to former CEOs, a crosscheck on zkill, an API key and you would know most of the things.

And finally again: this is an official playstyle in EVE - advertised even by FC in their videos to be something you can do in the game if you want. Infiltration, Espionage, Robbery, Ganking, Friendly Fire, Bring down an Empire to its knees.

I mean you also don’t report every veldspar roid that gets mined to the forums or do you somewhere?
